description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardDialogProvider' which extends 'AnySoftKeyboardService'. It manages dialog interactions, including showing toast messages and option dialogs, for the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app. It also contains inner classes for dialog data and dialog presentation logic.

classes.name: OptionsDialogData
classes.description: Data class encapsulating dialog options such as title, icon, options list, click handler, and optional extra presenter.

classes.name: ImeDialogPresenter
classes.description: Inner class implementing dialog presentation logic, setting up dialog UI and handling dialog lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog controller when the service is created.

methods.name: showToastMessage
methods.description: Displays a toast message with specified text and duration.

methods.name: showOptionsDialogWithData
methods.description: Displays an options dialog with provided data such as title, icon, options, and click handler.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Resets the dialog controller when the input view is created.

methods.name: handleCloseRequest
methods.description: Handles close requests, dismissing dialogs if needed.

methods.name: closeGeneralOptionsDialog
methods.description: Dismisses the general options dialog if it is showing.
